title: Chapter 764
paragraphs: Chapter 764
187. People to Find, Unexpected Clues (5)
The reason why Jin mentioned Loki's purpose to Orgal was to gauge whether the two were in a cooperative relationship.
'Seeing him so surprised, could it be that he had no idea about Loki's intentions? It doesn’t seem like he's pretending.'
If that's the case, it does feel like he gave away the information too easily, but it couldn’t really be considered a loss.
If the two are not in a cooperative relationship, then it means adding one more tracker to Loki without even using the power of the Bamel Alliance.
A silence lingered for a while.
Jin kept his mouth shut, looking at Orgal pondering the answer, and felt assured. He really seemed to be taken aback by this news.
"Listen, Orgal. Let's have a candid conversation without any deceit. It seems quite shocking to you as well. I heard this story from Padler."
"…From the King of Intelligence?"

"Yes. Padler said that Loki Ganesto was the one who betrayed the family a thousand years ago, colluded with the witch, and was the main culprit behind Tamara's corruption. Padler was also hurt by Loki. Before the duke died, he revealed that his goal was the resurrection of the sun god."
The golden aura of the subspace disappeared, revealing the scenery of the meeting room again.
"He also said that Loki drove all the ten knights of that time to death. The only one he kept alive was Veil, as it was necessary for his purpose."
"If that's the case, it's strange… I remember now that you mention it."
The historical manipulation applied to Loki was not entirely gone. Orgal was groping through memories that were gradually becoming clear only after Jin talked about Loki.
"What memories?"
"A thousand years ago, only once. There was a chance for the sun god to resurrect. At that very moment, when he could finally return to this world… The one who erased me from history was…"
Suddenly, Orgal's eyes were filled with such a huge grudge that even Jin was taken aback.
"It was Loki Ganesto. That insidious bug…! To remember it just now!"
Whooong-!
Just as when a dragon gets angry, gray wings spread out from Orgal's back. The enormous energy emanating from his body was causing the entire building to vibrate.
'Oh, this can’t be an act. It really looks like Orgal was fooled by Loki a thousand years ago, just like Padler said.'
A strong intuition came that he might be able to resolve the situation without getting his hands dirty.
"Hey, why are you suddenly getting mad, ah, town."
Jin blocked Veil's mouth as he was about to swear. There was no need to provoke Orgal, who might voluntarily look for Loki and even deal with him.
"Digging up information about Loki would be better handled by Orgal than our alliance.
For now, there's a limit to using Valeria's record magic to find Loki.
Once they start getting information, we can start sharing it bit by bit."
Alternatively, keeping a close eye on Kinsel, who was tracking Loki, was also a good strategy. It would be much easier than chasing Loki directly.
"Calm down, Orgal, I've never seen you so emotional before. Anyway, to sum up, you missed a critical opportunity to resurrect the Sun God because of Loki a thousand years ago?"
In fact, that was why Orgal was so sensitive today.
He had been recalling his 'opportunity a thousand years ago to resurrect the Sun God' while conducting the meeting until now.
However, he couldn't remember how he lost that opportunity, but now, thanks to Jin, he knew.
It was because of Loki.
"If it hadn't been for that disgusting bug, the world could have been complete again a thousand years ago."
"I can't agree with that, but Run Kandel has a blood price to pay to Loki Ganesto."
"A blood price? You speak as if Loki is still alive."
"He is alive. My sister met him not long ago. Valeria, can you show him that record?"
The record of the words left by Loki Ganesto had been blurred since it was in Runtia's subspace.
Instead, Valeria opened the record window and informed Orgal that she had reviewed that record.

"The blurred sentence here was about something I couldn't handle when my father came back from the Black Sea someday. It was what Loki said to my sister, offering her a contract. Loki is still alive, thanks to the witch giving him immortality."
Orgal gradually calmed his emotions and regained his composure. As his anger subsided, Jin's actions seemed strange.
'Why is Jin Runkandel so freely giving away this information without any compensation?'
Jin seemed to see right through him.
"You seem taken aback that I'm giving you this high-level information so easily, but I'm telling you this because I have something to gain as well."
"I'm bothered that the record about Loki is blurred. I can't help but think that the blurred part might mean you're in collusion with Loki and trying to trick me."

"Really? You think I would ally with someone as dark and unidentified as Loki... it's a shame to hear that, even though our temporary alliance has ended. Who was it that defeated the evil god, Orgal?"
"People can change at any time."

"Even if I am in collusion with Loki, as you say, what's the problem? Find out, and if it seems like your paranoid delusion is true, you can just hit me then. You were ready to fight me nonchalantly just a while ago."
"Right... I understand your intentions. You want to use me to track Loki."
"It feels like we're finally having a proper conversation, Orgal. Even if it's not a temporary alliance like last time, how about we cooperate temporarily?"
"You mean use, not cooperate. But I'll play along."
In fact, Orgal had no other choice.
Even if he refused, Jin had a high chance of figuring out the trajectories of Kinsel's tracking party through Valeria and Moomyung anyway.
Besides, if Loki were to find Runtia again, Kinsel would have no way of verifying it.
If Jin wasn't siding with Loki, there was no reason to refuse. From Orgal's perspective, he could always get Valeria's help whenever he found a clue about Loki.
"Good, it seems we've settled this issue. Now, shall we move on to the steel trade?"
"Last time, the King of Tikhan just spouted nonsense and left. He wanted to buy steel at a higher price during these times."
"I added more information about Loki."
At Jin's brazen words, Orgal chuckled.
"I can't count that as a value. It's not our job to do your dirty work."
"I'm offering double the money than last time."
"Do you really want to buy steel?"
"Yes. Honestly, aren't you making a profit just by getting the money? I know you have a surplus."
"Can you afford it? I heard you're in the middle of reconstructing Hupester."
"As long as you don't ask for cash, any amount."

"Unfortunately, that's still not good enough. Honestly, I thought I could get some amazing offer if you came in person, but it's disappointing. Unless you're willing to share your technology, don't even dream of trading steel."
From that moment, Jin put on a theatrical show of expressions. One of frustration and anger, but without showing it.
"That's too much. It feels more like a loss to have your technology improved than us making enough ships for a power boost."
Luckily, Orgal smiled softly, seeming to take the bait.
"You seem very confident in your military power. Are you relying on Tusin and Murakan? Anyway, the negotiation is over."
"I'll take my leave. If you change your mind, you can contact me in Tikhan at any time. But then, you'll have to trade under worse conditions."
"I won't need to, so stop bothering me about the steel issue. I'll contact you if something unusual happens with Loki."
When Jin and his party left the headquarters, Shagal found Orgal.
"Chief."
"Shagal."
"Jin Luncandle knew the name of Zito."
"You seem surprised he suddenly mentioned Zito. The fact that he knows Zito means nothing other than wanting you not to become overly curious."
"I thought as much. However, Jin Luncandle asked me about the Demon Realm."
"Did you answer?"
"Yes, he offered value for my response."
"I felt the delay. You fell for it in an instant."
"Embarrassingly, it was a great lesson for me. I only told him that there is not one Demon Realm. He then asked if your jurisdiction and Demon King Zito's were different and left."
"I see."
"Did I make a mistake?"
"No, Jin Luncandle will soon find out that much information anyway. It's not worth worrying about since he can't do anything about it even when he knows."
"I understand."
"I'm going to write a letter now, go to the Third Demon Realm and deliver it to your father. I need the help of the magic circles."
The next destination of the Red Owl was the Wantararmo Forest.
As Jin's party appeared at the entrance of the forest, they were greeted by the Mausoleum tribe Neru, Lulu, and Miru. Valeria had sent them a letter in advance.
They had forgotten their friend, the former housekeeper of Luncandle, Lreat Damiro Yul.
"Have you been waiting long?"
"No, we've only been waiting for a week."
"It seems like you've been waiting a long time... I'm sorry."
"Don't worry about it! We've been having fun talking with Ms. Shilra."
The third tomb of Temar where Lreat was, originally existed in the hideout of the Mausoleum tribe, but it was destroyed by the Spirit Corps right after Jin's visit.
Therefore, Valeria concluded that to enter the tomb where Lreat is again, she would need something related to Lreat, like the subspace of Runtia.
Veil, the sword of Padrer, Silus, and Lreat's sister Shilra.
Even if she used all of these elements, if she couldn't open the door to the destroyed hideout of the Mausoleum tribe again, finding Lreat would become difficult.
"Let's go and check. In my opinion, it will work. When I took a bit of Ms. Shilra's energy and went near the destroyed hideout, there was a strange reaction."
Thinking of the terrible loneliness Lreat must be experiencing, Jin moved his steps into the forest.
